input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 is the only audit/verification right binding us (searches for audit, inspection, verification and remote access to Customer systems returned nothing further; § 23 has no operative text). It satisfies every preferred element: once per twelve months, thirty days' prior written notice, normal business hours, off-site where practicable, independent auditor bound by confidentiality, Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds five percent, and Vendor and its auditor may not access Customer systems directly. Section 22.3 (findings are our Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement) runs in our favour and is not flagged. No redline needed.
